title: 3.15 Review: new people, new homes
unit_title: Meeting people and talking about them
unit_outcome: Introduce people and answer introductions, use the short forms of be, answer yes/no questions in short, compare ages, talk about languages, nationalities and jobs, describe people, say whose things are, give an address and say what you want to be.
goal: Review every A1+ Unit 3 step with new people: introductions, short forms of be, short answers, ages, both, languages and nationalities, jobs, hair, 's, whose and hers, addresses with at, and want to be, with no new language.
grammar_function: A follow-up of A1 3.15 Unit 3 Review: A1 reviews Unit 3 with fresh scenes; A1+ 3.15 reviews every A1+ Unit 3 step with ten fresh photos of new people and no new language: This is my … and Nice to meet you (3.1), she's, he's and they're with -ing (3.2-3.3), No, he isn't (3.4), three years older than (3.5), twins and both (3.6), a Spanish cook who speaks Spanish (3.7-3.8), What does he do? and works in (3.9), his hair is long (3.10), the man's camera (3.11), Whose …? and hers (3.12), lives at eleven Park Street (3.13) and wants to be a farmer (3.14). 2.5's but, 2.11's shorter and 2.12's Stand up and Sit down come back. Nobody in the photos speaks in the first person (the cast's voices belong to the cast), so the teacher asks and the co-teacher answers; nationality and language are said, never read from a picture.
speaking_outcome: Introduce and describe new people, say how old they are, what they do and want to be, whose things are and where they live, with every Unit 3 form, at a natural pace.
